calls.title: GrowthBook <> SassyClassy - Intro
calls.summary: In this introductory call, GrowthBook (represented by Daniel Wathne and Growthbook Dorn) discussed their experimentation platform with SassyClassy (Edwin Molina, Head of IT, and Nadeem Pedarnig, likely CRO). Key pain points were flicker effects, poor performance, and inaccurate metrics from previous tools (Shoplift, VWO) on Shopify Plus; GrowthBook offers a client-side solution with Edge Workers to avoid flicker, flexible metrics via BigQuery, and advanced statistical methods, though the Shopify implementation would be custom and require engineering resources. Next steps: Daniel will share resources, set up a Slack channel, and schedule a demo; SassyClassy
